About this Event

Beginner Vinyasa Yoga
Ready to flow and find your Zen? Join our Beginner Vinyasa Yoga class in person! It's perfect for those new to yoga or anyone wanting a gentle, energizing workout. Expect fun, friendly vibes, easy-to-follow moves, and a chance to stretch, strengthen, and breathe. No pressure, just good times and good energy. Bring your mat and let's flow together!
